hypothesis: Verify whether the Next.js /api/poi/[...path] proxy propagates upstream HTTP 401/502 statuses faithfully instead of rewriting 401 or upstream failure into HTTP 200 [], which would both suppress apiFetch silent JWT refresh and cause usePoiPool to overwrite local IndexedDB POI records with an empty array.

Verify whether POST /api/sign-cloudinary rejects requests missing a whitelisted folder, rejects path traversal (.. or backslash), rejects unauthorized parameter keys outside timestamp/folder/public_id, and validates timestamp and public_id before signing.

Verify whether transient 5xx/offline failures during forceRefresh preserve backed-up tokens without prompting reauth or wiping localStorage in downstream callers, and whether an in-flight 401 exchange discards stale failure/latch side effects if credential fingerprints changed mid-flight via reanchorSessionWithKey.
Verify whether edge-shield explicitly sets workers_dev: false and preview_urls: false to prevent unintended default *.workers.dev public ingress exposure.
Verify whether verifyJwtSub strictly rejects missing, non-finite, non-numeric, or exp === 0 claims instead of allowing falsy exp values to bypass expiration verification.
